Rashi on Kiddushin 78a:10:1.hebrew: בתו פסולה - כדאמרן לעיל (קידושין דף עז.), מקיש זרעו לו: מה הוא מחלל זרעו, אף בנו מחלל זרעו:
Rashi on Kiddushin 78a:10:1.english: His daughter is unfit - As we said above (Kiddushin 77a), [Scripture] compares his offspring to him: Just as he profanes his offspring, so too his son profanes his offspring.

Rashi on Kiddushin 78a:11:1.hebrew: יצירתו בעבירה - שנתעברה אמו באיסור, אבל עובד כוכבים בעובדת כוכבים — אין עיבורו באיסור:
Rashi on Kiddushin 78a:11:1.english: His formation was through a transgression - For his mother became pregnant through a prohibition, but [in the case of] a gentile [man] with a gentile [woman], his conception was not through a prohibition.

Rashi on Kiddushin 78a:11:2.hebrew: כ"ג באלמנה כו' - וה"ה לכהן הדיוט בגרושה וחללה, דהא מיגמר גמירי מהדדי: מה כאן זרעו חולין, אף להלן זרעו חולין. הלכך, בכהן הדיוט נמי איכא למימר לא יחלל:
Rashi on Kiddushin 78a:11:2.english: A High Priest [who marries] a widow, etc. - The same applies to an ordinary priest [who marries] a divorcee or a ḥalala, for they are derived from one another: just as here [in the case of the High Priest] his offspring is ḥullin (profane), so too there [in the case of the ordinary priest] his offspring is ḥullin. Therefore, in the case of an ordinary priest too, there is [the law of] "he shall not profane".

Rashi on Kiddushin 78a:12:1.hebrew: שכן ביאתו בעבירה - באלמנה זו; לפיכך, בת הנולדה מהן פסולה לכהונה, שהרי יצירתה בעבירה. תאמר בגר שנשא ישראלית, שביאתו בהיתר:
Rashi on Kiddushin 78a:12:1.english: In that his intercourse is a transgression - With this widow; therefore, a daughter born of them is disqualified from [marrying into] the priesthood, for her conception was in transgression. Would you say [the same] of a convert who married an Israelite woman, whose intercourse was permitted?

Rashi on Kiddushin 78a:12:2.hebrew: חלל יוכיח - שנשא ישראלית, שאין ביאתו בעבירה:
Rashi on Kiddushin 78a:12:2.english: A ḥalal will prove [it] - [One] who married an Israelite woman, for his intercourse is not in transgression.

Rashi on Kiddushin 78a:13:1.hebrew: שאינן ברוב הקהל - שחלוקין משאר קהל, שזה יצירתו בעבירה, וזה ביאתו בעבירה:
Rashi on Kiddushin 78a:13:1.english: That they are unlike most of the congregation - In that they are distinct from the rest of the congregation, for this one's formation [was] through a transgression, and that one's act of intercourse [was] through a transgression.

Rashi on Kiddushin 78a:13:2.english: I will also bring a convert, who is not among most of the congregation - For he came from an unfit drop [of semen].

Rashi on Kiddushin 78a:15:1.hebrew: מצרי ראשון - שנשא מצרית ראשונה, שאין יצירתו בעבירה ולא ביאתו בעבירה, ובתו פסולה — דהא שניה היא, ורחמנא אמר: "דור שלישי":
Rashi on Kiddushin 78a:15:1.english: A first-generation Egyptian - [One] who married a first-generation female Egyptian, as neither his conception was through transgression nor was his intercourse through transgression, and [yet] his daughter is disqualified [from the priesthood], since she is a second-generation [Egyptian], and the Merciful One stated: "[The] third generation [may enter]":

Rashi on Kiddushin 78a:17:1.hebrew: שאינן ברוב קהל - שזה יצירתו בעבירה, וזה אינו ראוי לבא בקהל. וגר אינו ברוב קהל — שבא מטפה פסולה:
Rashi on Kiddushin 78a:17:1.english: That they are not among the majority of the congregation - For this one's conception was through a transgression, and that one is not fit to enter into the congregation. And a convert is not among the majority of the congregation — as he comes from a disqualified drop [of semen]:

Rashi on Kiddushin 78a:18:1.hebrew: פוסלין בביאתן - את אשה מן הכהונה, כדתניא לעיל בפירקין (קידושין דף עד:): בן ט' שנים ויום א', גר עמוני ומואבי כו', תאמר בגר שאינו פוסל בביאתו:
Rashi on Kiddushin 78a:18:1.english: They disqualify through their intercourse - a woman from marrying into the priesthood, as it was taught above in our chapter (Kiddushin 74b): "A nine-year-and-one-day-old Ammonite and Moabite convert, etc.; can you say this of a convert, who does not disqualify through his intercourse?"

Rashi on Kiddushin 78a:18:2.hebrew: מהאי דינא - מה חלל שבא מטפה כשרה פוסל, גר שבא מטפה פסולה לכ"ש כו':
Rashi on Kiddushin 78a:18:2.english: From this derivation - Just as a ḥalal, who comes from a fit drop [of seed], disqualifies [a woman through intercourse], a convert, who comes from an unfit drop [of seed], all the more so, etc.:

Rashi on Kiddushin 78a:19:1.hebrew: רש"א כו' - הרי ארבע מחלוקת בדבר: לר"י, בת גר זכר פסולה, ואפי' נשא ישראלית. לר' אליעזר, אי איכא צד אחד ישראל — מכשיר; ומיהו, גר וגיורת — בתו פסולה. ולר' יוסי, אפי' גר שנשא גיורת — בתו כשרה; ומיהו, הורתה ולידתה בקדושה בעי. ור' שמעון, אפי' גיורת עצמה מכשיר, ובלבד שלא תהא ראויה לביאה בגיותה, דתיפוק לה מכלל זונה:
Rashi on Kiddushin 78a:19:1.english: Rabbi Shimon says, etc. - Behold, there are four [differing] opinions on the matter: According to Rabbi Yehuda, the daughter of a male convert is disqualified [from marrying into the priesthood], even if he married a Jewish woman. According to Rabbi Eliezer, if there is one Jewish side, he deems [her] fit; however, [in the case of] a male convert and a female convert, his daughter is disqualified. And according to Rabbi Yosei, even [in the case of] a male convert who married a female convert, his daughter is fit; however, he requires her conception and her birth [to have been] in sanctity. And Rabbi Shimon deems even a female convert herself fit, provided that she was not fit for sexual intercourse during her gentileship, so that she is excluded from the category of a zonah.

Rashi on Kiddushin 78a:19:2.hebrew: והרי פינחס היה ביניהם - בין היוצאים למלחמת מדין, שנאמר להם המקרא הזה:
Rashi on Kiddushin 78a:19:2.english: And behold, Pinehas was among them - Among those who went out to the war of Midian, to whom this verse was said:

Rashi on Kiddushin 78a:1:1.hebrew: זונה משוי לה - ללקות כהן הבא עליה עוד משום זונה, שהרי נבעלה בעילת זנות מאסור לה:
Rashi on Kiddushin 78a:1:1.english: Renders her a zona - For a priest who subsequently engages in intercourse with her to be flogged on account of [her being] a zona, for behold, she engaged in intercourse of zenut with [a man] forbidden to her.

Rashi on Kiddushin 78a:1:2.english: He does not render her a ḥalala - And a second priest who engages in intercourse with her does not receive lashes on account of [her being] a ḥalala.

Rashi on Kiddushin 78a:1:3.hebrew: חזר ובא עליה - הוא או כהן אחר — עשאה חללה, שהרי אסורה לו משום זונה, שאינו נוהג אלא בכהונה:
Rashi on Kiddushin 78a:1:3.english: [If] he again engaged in intercourse with her - [Whether] he or another priest, he renders her a ḥalala, for she is forbidden to him as a zona, which [prohibition] applies only to the priesthood.

Rashi on Kiddushin 78a:20:1.hebrew: כל זרע - כלומר, כל עיקר הקרוי זרע היינו מן האב, לאפוקי בת גר זכר:
Rashi on Kiddushin 78a:20:1.english: The entire seed - That is to say, all that is primarily called “seed” is from the father, to exclude the daughter of a male convert.

Rashi on Kiddushin 78a:20:2.hebrew: מקצת זרע - אפי' זרע כחוש, כגון מן האם — גר שנשא ישראלית:
Rashi on Kiddushin 78a:20:2.english: Part of the seed - Even weak seed, such as from the mother — [in the case of] a convert who married an Israelite woman.

Rashi on Kiddushin 78a:21:1.english: One who was seeded in Israel - That her conception be in sanctity:

Rashi on Kiddushin 78a:21:2.hebrew: מי שנזרעו בתוליה בישראל - שצמחו וגמרו בתוליה משבאה לכלל ישראל, דהיינו: כשנעשית בת שלש, גמרו בתוליה לביאה, שאם תבעל מכאן ואילך — אינן חוזרין; אבל קודם שלש, כל שעה הם חוזרין וצומחים ובאין. והכי דריש לקרא: "בתולות מזרע בית ישראל" — בתולי' שלה יהו מזרע גידולי יהודי:
Rashi on Kiddushin 78a:21:2.english: One whose virginity was seeded in Israel - That her hymen grew and completed [its formation] once she entered the fold of Israel; that is, when she became three years old, her hymen became finalized with respect to intercourse, for if she engages in intercourse from this point onward, it does not return; but prior to [age] three, it continuously returns and grows back. And this is how [Rabbi Shimon ben Yoḥai] expounds the verse: "Virgins of the seed of the house of Israel" — her virginity must be from the seed of the bodily growth of a Jew.

Rashi on Kiddushin 78a:2:1.hebrew: כ"ג באלמנה כו' - וה"ה לכהן הדיוט בגרושה וחללה, דהא מיגמר גמירי מהדדי: מה כאן זרעו חולין — אף להלן זרעו חולין. הלכך, בכהן הדיוט נמי איכא לא יחלל:
Rashi on Kiddushin 78a:2:1.english: A High Priest with a widow, etc. - And the same applies to an ordinary priest with a divorcee or a ḥalalah, for they are learned from each other: just as here [regarding a High Priest] his offspring is profaned, so too there [regarding an ordinary priest] his offspring is profaned. Therefore, in [the case of] an ordinary priest as well, there is [the prohibition of] “he shall not profane.”

Rashi on Kiddushin 78a:2:2.hebrew: לא יקח - משום קידושין, ובביאה שלאחר קידושין הוא דקאמר: לוקה שתים:
Rashi on Kiddushin 78a:2:2.english: “He shall not take” - [This prohibition is incurred] on account of betrothal, and it is regarding intercourse following betrothal that he says [that] he is flogged twice.

Rashi on Kiddushin 78a:2:3.english: Due to “he shall not profane” - For he profaned her.

Rashi on Kiddushin 78a:2:4.english: And let him also be flogged - Due to the profanation of his offspring.

Rashi on Kiddushin 78a:2:5.hebrew: בשלא גמר ביאתו - דליכא חילול זרע, אבל היא נתחללה בהעראה, כדתנן ביבמות (דף נג:): אחד המערה ואחד הגומר קנה, ולא חילק בין ביאה לביאה:
Rashi on Kiddushin 78a:2:5.english: Where he did not complete his act of intercourse - For there is no profanation of offspring, but she was profaned through initial intercourse [ha’arah], as we learned in a Mishnah in Yevamot (53b): “Whether one who performs initial intercourse or one who completes [the act], he has acquired [the yevama],” and it did not distinguish between [one type of] intercourse and [another type of] intercourse.

Rashi on Kiddushin 78a:3:1.english: A widow and a divorcée - [He] engaged in intercourse with a widow who is [also] a divorcée.

Rashi on Kiddushin 78a:3:2.english: Due to two labels - Due to [the prohibition of] a widow and due to [the prohibition of] a divorcée.

Rashi on Kiddushin 78a:4:1.hebrew: שני שמות על זה כו' - ודאי שני שמות דקתני — גרושה ואלמנה קאמר; ומיהו, על כל אחת לוקה שתים: משום לא יקח ומשום לא יחלל:
Rashi on Kiddushin 78a:4:1.english: Two labels for this, etc. - Certainly, when it taught "two labels," it meant a divorcée and a widow; however, for each one he is flogged twice: on account of "he shall not take" and on account of "he shall not profane."

Rashi on Kiddushin 78a:5:1.hebrew: אלא על אחת - על שם גרושה הוא חייב על כל חיובים התלוים בה, אבל על חלוצה לא, דחלוצה לאו דאורייתא אלא דרבנן:
Rashi on Kiddushin 78a:5:1.english: Only on account of one - On account of the category of a divorcée he is liable for all liabilities dependent on it, but on account of a ḥalutza [he is] not, as [the prohibition of] a ḥalutza is not from the Torah, but rabbinic.

Rashi on Kiddushin 78a:7:1.hebrew: קידש - כ"ג או כהן הדיוט אחת מן הפסולות האמורות בענין:
Rashi on Kiddushin 78a:7:1.english: Betrothed - A High Priest or a common priest [betrothed] one of the disqualified women mentioned in the passage.

Rashi on Kiddushin 78a:7:2.hebrew: לא יקח - קידושין משמע, שהן הקונים אותה:
Rashi on Kiddushin 78a:7:2.english: He shall not take - [This] implies betrothal, as it is that which acquires her:

Rashi on Kiddushin 78a:7:3.hebrew: בעל לוקה - בעל אחר קידושין, לוקה שתים; לא בעל, אינו לוקה אפי אחת:
Rashi on Kiddushin 78a:7:3.english: [If] he engaged in intercourse, he is flogged - [If] he engaged in intercourse after betrothal, he is flogged twice; [if] he did not engage in intercourse, he is not flogged even once.

Rashi on Kiddushin 78a:8:1.hebrew: ומודה אביי - אע"ג דמחייב מלקות אקידושין באיסור כהונה, הכא הוא דכל חד וחד לאו באנפי נפשיה, ולא תלה הכתוב את זה בזה בפירוש. אבל ישראל המחזיר גרושתו משנשאת לאחר ונתארמלה או נתגרשה, אע"ג דכתיב "לא יוכל לשוב לקחתה", דהיינו אזהרה שלא יקדשנה — מודה הוא דאינו לוקה עד שיבעל, דבהדיא תלה רחמנא קידושין בביאה:
Rashi on Kiddushin 78a:8:1.english: And Abaye concedes - Even though he holds [one] liable for lashes for betrothal in [cases of] priestly prohibitions, it is there that each one is an independent negative commandment, and Scripture did not explicitly make one contingent upon the other. However, [in the case of] an Israelite who remarries his divorcée after she was married to another and became widowed or divorced, even though it is written: “He may not take her again,” which is a prohibition against betrothing her — he concedes that he is not flogged until he engages in intercourse, as the Merciful One explicitly made betrothal contingent upon intercourse.

Rashi on Kiddushin 78a:8:2.hebrew: לקחתה להיות לו לאשה - דכיון דקיחה הוא קידושין, להיות לו לאשה — אישות של ביאה קאמר:
Rashi on Kiddushin 78a:8:2.english: To take her to be his wife - For since “taking” is betrothal, “to be his wife” means matrimony through intercourse.

Rashi on Kiddushin 78a:9:1.hebrew: ומודה רבא - אע"ג דבעי באיסור כהונה תרתי, דוקא ביאה אחר קידושין הוא דבעי, דאקידושין לחודייהו לא לקי:
Rashi on Kiddushin 78a:9:1.english: And Rava concedes - Even though he requires two [acts] regarding the prohibition of priesthood, it is specifically intercourse after betrothal that he requires [in order to incur lashes], since for betrothal alone he is not flogged.

Rashi on Kiddushin 78a:9:2.hebrew: אבל בעל ולא קידש - מודה הוא שהבעילה אינה תלויה בקידושין, ד״לא יחלל״ אמר רחמנא, והרי חילל:
Rashi on Kiddushin 78a:9:2.english: But [if] he engaged in intercourse and did not betroth [her] - He concedes that [the prohibition of] intercourse is not contingent upon betrothal, as the Merciful One states, “He shall not profane,” and behold, he has profaned [her].

Rashi on Kiddushin 78a:9:3.hebrew: ושניהם מודים במחזיר גרושתו - אע"פ שלדברי שניהם כהן בפסולה לו לוקה על ביאה בלא קידושין, מודים הם בישראל המחזיר גרושתו משנישאת, שאם בעל ולא קידש — שאינו לוקה:
Rashi on Kiddushin 78a:9:3.english: And they both concede in [the case of] one who remarries his divorcée - Even though according to both of them a priest [who has intercourse] with [a woman] disqualified to him is flogged for intercourse without betrothal, they concede in [the case of] an Israelite who remarries his divorcée after she was married [to another], that if he had intercourse without betrothing [her], he is not flogged.

Rashi on Kiddushin 78a:9:4.hebrew: ה"ג דרך ליקוחין אסרה תורה - על הביאה לא פרט לאו, אלא על ידי ליקוחין, ד"לא יוכל לשוב לקחתה" כתיב:
Rashi on Kiddushin 78a:9:4.english: This is the text reading: The Torah forbade [it] through the manner of taking - Regarding intercourse [alone], [the Torah] did not specify a negative prohibition, but only by means of taking [in marriage], as it is written: "[He] may not return to take her" [Deuteronomy 24:4].

Tosafot on Kiddushin 78a:18:1.hebrew: ורבי יהודה גר נמי פוסל בביאתו ומייתי לה במה הצד - דחלל ומצרי ראשון. וא"ת: לר' יוסי, אמאי מכשיר במתני' בת גר? הוה לן למיפסל במה הצד שבהן דחלל ומצרי, כמו רבי יהודה! וצ"ל: דקסבר רבי יוסי, אין זו הצד השוה למילף מינייהו פסול לבת גר — שהרי בת חלל אינה פסולה לקהל ישראל, ובת מצרי ראשון פסולה לבא בקהל; ולא שייך למימר: "הצד השוה שבהן שאינן ברוב הקהל ובתו פסולה", כיון שאין פסול בנות שוה. ועוד, דוחק הוא לומר ולפרש "שאינן ברוב קהל" — היינו שבאחד מהם יש צד עבירה, ובאחרת הוא פסול לבא בקהל, דאין סברא לומר כן, דהא אינן שוין:
Tosafot on Kiddushin 78a:18:1.english: "And Rabbi Yehuda [holds that] a convert also disqualifies through his act of intercourse, and he derives it by the common factor" - [Namely, that] of a chalal and an Egyptian of the first [generation]. And if you say: According to Rabbi Yose, why does he declare the daughter of a convert fit in the Mishnah? We should disqualify [her] through their common factor of a chalal and an Egyptian, like Rabbi Yehuda! And it must be said that Rabbi Yose maintains [that] this is not [a valid] common factor from which to derive a disqualification for the daughter of a convert, for the daughter of a chalal is not disqualified from [entering] the congregation of Israel, whereas the daughter of an Egyptian of the first [generation] is disqualified from entering the congregation; and it is not applicable to say: "Their common factor is that they are not among the majority of the congregation and his daughter is disqualified," since the disqualification of [their] daughters is not identical. And furthermore, it is forced to say and explain [that] "they are not among the majority of the congregation" means that in one of them there is an aspect of transgression, while in the other he is disqualified from entering the congregation — for there is no logic to say so, since they are not equivalent.

Tosafot on Kiddushin 78a:18:2.hebrew: [במה הצד בהאי דינא - קשיא לר"י: דהא לא שייך פסול ביאה גבי מצרי אלא כשנשא בת ישראל, דאי במצרית — כבר היא פסולה; ואיכא למיפרך: "מה להצד השוה שבהן שכן יש בהן צד עבירה", כדלעיל כו'] — ת"י:
Tosafot on Kiddushin 78a:18:2.english: ["By the common factor, from this halakha" - This is difficult to the Ri: For disqualification through intercourse is applicable regarding an Egyptian only when he has married an Israelite woman, for if [he had intercourse] with an Egyptian woman, she is already disqualified; and one can refute [this derivation]: "What [is notable] about their common denominator? That they have an aspect of transgression," as [stated] above, etc.] — [Tosafot Yeshanim]

Tosafot on Kiddushin 78a:9:1.hebrew: מ"ט דרך ליקוחין אסרה תורה - פי': ד"לא יוכל בעלה הראשון לשוב לקחתה" כתיב. ה"ג בקונט', ול"ג: "דרך הויה אסרה תורה" — לפי דמהאי קרא דהויה מפיק לעיל דבעי ביאה להתחייב המחזיר גרושתו, והשתא הויה מפיק מינה שאין חייב במחזיר גרושתו אלא א"כ קידש?! ושמא י"ל דנוכל לגרוס "דרך הויה אסרה תורה", לפי דלעיל דריש ליה מלאשה, דמשמע דרך של אישות, דהיינו ביאה; והכא דריש מלהיות, דמשמע הויה, שהן קידושין:
Tosafot on Kiddushin 78a:9:1.english: What is the reason? "The Torah forbade through the manner of taking" - Explanation: For it is written: "Her first husband may not return to take her" (Deuteronomy 24:4). This is the reading in the Kuntres [Rashi], and we do not read: "The Torah forbade through the manner of havayah [becoming]," because from this verse of havayah [the Gemara] derived above that intercourse is required for one who remarries his divorcée to become liable, and now it would derive from havayah that one is not liable for remarrying his divorcée unless he betrothed?! And perhaps one can say that we can [indeed] read: "The Torah forbade through the manner of havayah," because above [the Gemara] expounded it from "as a wife" [le’isha], which implies the manner of matrimony, which is intercourse; and here it expounds from "to be" [lihyot], which implies havayah [becoming], which is betrothal.
